from openai import OpenAI
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
import numpy as np

client = OpenAI()
emb = SentenceTransformer("{{embed_model}}")
history, DOCS, VECS = [], [], None

def ingest(docs):
    global DOCS, VECS
    DOCS = docs; VECS = emb.encode(docs, normalize_embeddings=True)

def ask(q: str) -> str:
    qv = emb.encode([q], normalize_embeddings=True)
    ctx = "\n".join(DOCS[i] for i in np.argsort(-(VECS @ qv.T).flatten())[:3])
    history.append({"role": "user", "content": f"Ctx:\n{ctx}\n\n{q}"})
    r = client.chat.completions.create(model="{{model_name}}", messages=history)
    reply = r.choices[0].message.content
    history.append({"role": "assistant", "content": reply})
    return reply
